description: Read this once before you add or shape the data of a report: how to send a CSV or an Excel workbook and pick the range of a sheet, how to check a figure with queryReportData, how to shape data with previewReportDatasheetChanges, renderReportSlides and saveReportDatasheetChanges, and the query model those changes write. It needs no report.
name: getReportDataGuide
title: Get the data guide
